claim: Villa Otrang outdoor area is freely accessible year-round; protective buildings with mosaics open April–October Wed–Sun 10:00–17:00; free admission.
quote: Außenanlage und zwei Schutzbauten mit Mosaiken sind von April bis Oktober von Mittwoch bis Sonntag, 10 bis 17 Uhr, geöffnet.

claim: Villa Otrang was a major Roman villa rustica with a manor house of over 60 rooms, baths, hypocaust heating and surviving mosaic floors.
quote: The manor house was magnificent in size with over 60 rooms. In addition to the impressive manor house, the complex included several baths, a heating system (hypocaust) and a temple area.

claim: Villa Otrang is located near Fließem about 5 km north of Bitburg; 14 of its 66 rooms once had mosaics, four of which survive nearly intact.
quote: Die Villa Otrang ist international bekannt für ihre prachtvollen Mosaikfußböden, mit denen 14 der 66 Räume des Herrenhauses ehemals ausgestattet waren, von denen vier bis heute fast unversehrt erhalten sind.

claim: The Roman double burial chamber at Nehren preserves original 4th-century wall and vault paintings in the left chamber – unique north of the Alps – viewable through a window in the door.
quote: The burial chamber of the first tomb is the only ancient room still existing in the Rhineland where the original paintings on the walls and vault are largely preserved.

claim: The Nehren Roman tombs are two reconstructed funerary temples; chamber I measures 2.6 m wide, 4.3 m deep, 3 m high with a barrel vault and best-preserved vault paintings north of the Alps.
quote: Die besser erhaltene Grabkammer I des linken Tempels ist 2,6 m breit, 4,3 m tief und 3 m hoch und besitzt ein Tonnengewölbe.

claim: Mittelmosel-Museum (Barockvilla Böcking, Traben-Trarbach) reopens 1 April 2026; Tue–Fri 10:00–17:00 and Sat–Sun 12:00–16:00; adults €5, family €10.
quote: From April 1, 2026, the museum is open Tuesday to Friday from 10:00 to 17:00, and Saturday to Sunday from 12:00 to 16:00.

claim: The Mittelmoselmuseum's 20+ rooms hold Roman and Frankish archaeology, Mont Royal fortress finds, 1,100 Delft tiles in the dining room, and the Spies collection of furniture and art.
quote: The museum houses an extensive collection on the history of Traben-Trarbach, including archaeological finds from Roman and Frankish periods. The dining room is decorated with 1,100 Delft tiles.

claim: The Cusanus-Geburtshaus museum in Bernkastel-Kues is closed December 2025 through February 2026, reopening in March 2026 for the season.
quote: Das Cusanus-Geburtshaus (Museum) ist in den Monaten Dezember 2025, Januar und Februar 2026 geschlossen!

claim: The St-Nikolaus-Hospital / Cusanusstift library in Bernkastel-Kues – holding 314 medieval manuscripts from Cusanus's bequest – is only viewable on guided tours April–October Tue 10:30 and Fri 15:00.
quote: The library contains 314 manuscripts from the 9th to 15th centuries... Visits are offered from April to October on Tuesdays at 10:30 AM and Fridays at 3:00 PM.

claim: Vulkanhaus Strohn summer hours from 1 April 2026 are Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00; admission €3 adult, €2 reduced, €6 family.
quote: From April 1, 2026 onwards, it's open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 17:00... Admission costs €3 for adults, €2 for reduced rates, and a family card (couple and children) is €6.

claim: Vulkanhaus Strohn is the central exhibition house of the Geopark Vulkaneifel, presenting the geology and volcanic history of the Eifel with the famous lava bomb outside.
quote: Das Vulkanhaus Strohn ist das zentrale Ausstellungshaus des Natur- und Geoparks Vulkaneifel.

claim: Kreismuseum Bitburg-Prüm covers regional history with Stone Age, Roman and Frankish finds; open March–October Tue–Wed 11–17, Thu–Fri & Sun 14–17 (closed Mon, Sat).
quote: March - October: Tuesdays and Wednesdays 11 AM - 5 PM, Thursdays, Fridays, and Sundays 2 PM - 5 PM (closed Mondays and Saturdays)
